requirement_text.REQ-060: Port src/engine/pin_rebind.zig (388 lines, R-Co's PIN-05) as Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/N -- the SOLE write path to an instance's effective pin set after INSTANCE_STARTED (PIN-05 AC5). Its whole reason to exist is that pins are otherwise immutable: no scheduled job, catalog publication or definition promotion may change a running instance's pins, so there is exactly one deliberate, audited, explicit way to change them. Takes explicit {kind, ref, version} entries plus a MANDATORY reason. A request with no reason, an empty entries list, or a malformed entry is rejected with a distinct invalid-input error (PIN-05 AC4). Validates every named ref exists in the instance's CURRENT effective pin set (via REQ-059's merge_effective_pins). A ref absent from that set returns a distinct UnknownPinRef error and applies NONE of the entries in the request (PIN-05 AC2) -- all-or-nothing, so a partially-applied rebind is impossible. Rejects a terminal instance (COMPLETED, CANCELLED, or ERROR) with a distinct InstanceNotRebindable error (PIN-05 AC3). Note the naming mismatch R-Co's own file documents: PIN-05's requirement text says FAILED but instance.zig's InstanceStatus enum has no FAILED variant -- the codebase's ERROR status is the one meant. Letflow's own status enum (REQ-023/REQ-043) likewise has ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/ERROR and no FAILED, so treat ERROR as terminal for rebind purposes and say so in the moduledoc rather than leaving a reader to wonder whether a status is missing. On success, appends exactly one INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event carrying {ref, prior_version, new_version, actor, reason} per CHANGED entry, atomically (PIN-05 AC1). An entry whose requested version equals the current pinned version is not a change and contributes no payload entry. Concurrency: R-Co uses SELECT FOR UPDATE NOWAIT and surfaces contention as a distinct ConcurrentModification error rather than blocking, matching its CompleteTaskError convention. Port that convention -- REQ-055's zero-cross-instance-contention rule applies here too. SCOPE BOUNDARY: POST /api/v1/instances/{id}/rebind-pins is S4 (api-surface); this requirement returns tagged tuples and S4 owns the status mapping.

task.description: Design Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3, the sole write path to an instance's effective pin set after INSTANCE_STARTED. Covers: mandatory-reason + non-empty-entries + well-formed-entry validation with a distinct invalid-input error per violation category; all-or-nothing UnknownPinRef validation against REQ-059's PinResolver.reconstruct_effective_pins/2 + pin_for/3 (a ref absent from the current effective set rejects the WHOLE request, applying none of the entries); a three-way InstanceNotRebindable check (COMPLETED/CANCELLED/ERROR -- deliberately NOT InstanceProjection.terminal?/1, which excludes :error) run before any write; a ported SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT + distinct ConcurrentModification convention (the only existing precedent is Reconstruction.write_back/3's lock_projection_nowait/2, not cancel_instance/3's own blocking FOR UPDATE); the exact INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND payload shape (already dictated by PinResolver.apply_rebind_event/2's already-shipped reader: payload["entries"] each with kind/ref/new_version, plus prior_version for AC1's audit requirement); and confirmation that REQ-053/REQ-059's reconstruction path needs zero code changes since merge_effective_pins/2 already folds every INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event found. Branch feature/WF02-REQ060-20260819 already exists and is checked out (Step 00 PASSED). Read lib/letflow/engine/pin_resolver.ex (the actual shipped REQ-059 code, not just its design doc -- the design doc drifted slightly), lib/letflow/engine/reconstruction.ex (the NOWAIT precedent), lib/letflow/engine.ex in full (cancel_instance/3's own Multi shape as the closest sibling, plus the EE-12/REQ-055 lock inventory), and lib/letflow/event_store.ex + registry.ex (append/2's event-type-registration requirement -- confirm which event types tenant provisioning auto-registers vs. which a caller must register itself) before designing.
acceptance_criteria: a valid rebind on a running instance appends exactly one INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event carrying ref, prior_version, new_version, actor and reason for each CHANGED entry, and an entry whose requested version already matches contributes no payload entry

a rebind naming a ref absent from the current effective pin set returns a distinct UnknownPinRef error and applies NONE of the entries -- verified by reading the effective pin set back and confirming it is unchanged, including for the entries that were individually valid
a rebind against a COMPLETED, CANCELLED or ERROR instance returns a distinct InstanceNotRebindable error, with each of the three statuses tested
a rebind with a missing or empty reason, an empty entries list, and a malformed entry each return a distinct invalid-input error
after a rebind, REQ-059's effective pin set reflects the new versions and REQ-053's reconstruction derives the same set from INSTANCE_STARTED plus INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND, with no catalog read

lock contention surfaces as a distinct ConcurrentModification error rather than blocking, and the moduledoc states that ERROR (not a non-existent FAILED status) is the terminal status PIN-05's text refers to

result.summary: Design produced at lib/letflow/design/req060-pin-rebind.md. Public surface: Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3(instance_id, rebind_attrs(), rebind_opts()) -> {:ok, rebind_result()} | rebind_error() -- the module's only public function, called directly by a future S4 route (no Letflow.Engine wrapper, mirroring how Reconstruction.reconstruct_instance/2 is also called directly). Two-phase call-order spec mirrors cancel_instance/3's own shape: a pure/read-only pre-transaction phase (instance_id cast, actor_id/idempotency_key/reason/entries presence+shape validation, one distinct error atom per violation category) followed by one Ecto.Multi -- M1 SELECT instance_projections FOR UPDATE NOWAIT (rescues Postgrex lock_not_available into {:concurrent_modification, instance_id}, ported from Reconstruction.lock_projection_nowait/2, the only existing NOWAIT precedent in this codebase -- cancel_instance/3 itself uses plain blocking FOR UPDATE, confirmed by direct read, so this is a deliberate divergence from that sibling, not an oversight), M2 a NEW three-way eligibility predicate (COMPLETED/CANCELLED/ERROR -> InstanceNotRebindable) that deliberately does NOT call InstanceProjection.terminal?/1 since that predicate excludes :error by design (confirmed instance_projection.ex:178-179), M3 PinResolver.reconstruct_effective_pins/2 run inside the same locked transaction (this is what makes the ConcurrentModification guarantee real -- a second concurrent rebind can't observe this call's pending event), M4 all-or-nothing per-entry PinResolver.pin_for/3 lookup against the effective set (first miss halts the whole pass, UnknownPinRef, zero entries applied), M5 pure changed-entries computation (unchanged-version entries contribute nothing), M6 EventStore.append/2 with the INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND payload. Confirmed by direct read of the shipped (not just designed) pin_resolver.ex that PinResolver.merge_effective_pins/2 already folds ALL INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND events (not just the most recent -- REQ-059's own design-doc OQ-2 resolved in the direction this requirement needs) and that apply_rebind_event/2 already reads exactly payload["entries"] with "kind"/"ref"/"new_version" string keys -- so this design's payload shape is dictated by already-shipped code, not freely chosen, and zero Reconstruction/PinResolver code changes are part of this requirement (Section 7). Also surfaced and documented a load-bearing finding not stated in REQ-060's own text: EventStore.append/2 requires its event_type to be pre-registered in event_type_registry or the whole append fails with {:error, :unknown_event_type} -- TenantProvisioning auto-registers ONLY "INSTANCE_STARTED"; TASK_COMPLETED/INSTANCE_CANCELLED are registered by their own test fixtures (confirmed test/letflow/engine_cancel_instance_test.exs:63-97), and this design has PinRebind follow that same precedent for INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND (does not self-register), flagged as OQ-1 for REVIEWER. Five open questions recorded explicitly in Section 9 (OQ-1 registration responsibility, OQ-2 missing-vs-empty-reason atom granularity, OQ-3 whether a zero-changed-entries rebind still appends an event, OQ-4 whether ConcurrentModification should scope to rebind-vs-rebind only or any concurrent instance_projections lock holder, OQ-5 standing no-R-Co-source-available caveat) -- none silently resolved. Verified post-write by grep for 'def '/'defp '/'with {:ok'/'case ... do$' across the whole document: zero matches, confirming no real Elixir function body or control-flow syntax, only @type/@spec declarations (matching the accepted REQ-059 design's own precedent for what CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR passed).
